ir_analysis.scope: ReadConst flags zero plus marked ReadConstBuffer sharp sources at flatbuf offset zero in pre-res-patch IR. Counts include instructions later removed; they are not counts of live GPU accesses. No host-uniform expression was found among these rejected sources.
ir_analysis.decision: Do not replace loops or workgroup IDs with a host constant. Existing retained finite transforms do not justify wholesale source replacement. General indexed resource support remains open.

changes.change: Use stage image resource is_written metadata for every descriptor write, including null/rejected images; do not inspect stale/unconstructed ImageDesc for a null slot.
changes.provenance: Same independent resource-role tracking is present in retained source-0 and source-1 vk_rasterizer.cpp. Selected port only; no indexed resource expansion, residency budget or title condition imported.

changes.change: Accumulate every storage use during the first image-binding pass so shared sampled/storage images use GENERAL in either descriptor order within that stage.
changes.negative_reproduction: Old storage-first/sample-second binding transitions to SHADER_READ_ONLY after retaining a storage descriptor with GENERAL. Reverse order passed, exposing order dependence.

validation.production_extraction: Actual BindTextures body through all image descriptor writes; unchanged sampler loop excluded. Real pinned Vulkan C++ headers; stub cache/device/memory with recorded operations; std::vector stands in for Boost small_vector.
validation.cases_detail: 16 reused null/rejected-slot combinations; four sampled/storage orders including three-mip storage arrays; four ordinary sampled/storage/depth controls.

attempts: Initial fixture compile stopped for unavailable Boost headers; replaced container with explicit std::vector stand-in.
Second fixture compile exposed wrong stub return type for ImageId; corrected stub.
All candidate cases and independent negative controls then completed.
limits: No new PS4 instruction semantics are introduced; these changes correct Vulkan descriptor metadata and layout use.
Recorded cache operations do not prove real Vulkan execution, cross-stage image rebinding, or image growth/alias lifecycle.
This patch is not proven to remove the captured black screens.
validation.final_check: Final minimal implementation uses stage.images directly; all 24 cases, four negative controls, seven existing contracts and whitespace checks pass.
